sources.title: Package qwen3.5-2b-gguf · GitHub
sources.snippet: The images still bake the selected model at build time for offline startup. That means changing MODEL_ID at runtime does not fetch a new model; it only affects the env inside an image that already contains that model. For the CPU image, MODEL_ID is the Hugging Face repo and MODEL_FILE is the exact GGUF file to bake into the image.
